implementation.name: original-v1-tiling-diagram
implementation.scope: A selected 2 × 2 output tile reduces K = 6 through three K tiles of width 2. The source layout includes a resident accumulator inset.
implementation.question: What stays resident while the K tiles change?

purpose: Retain the same C partial while matching A/B tiles advance, then write and release in dependency order.
storyboard: Stage matching A/B tiles for the current K interval.
Add each reduction term to the same resident C partial.
Retire operands while preserving C across three slabs.
Write the complete output before releasing its accumulators.
guard: Fast accumulator state is distinct from output memory. Counts are toy logical work, not measured traffic or speed.
